title: The Heaven of Heavens Cannot Contain
description: The Heaven of Heavens Cannot Contain in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: William Drennan wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 118 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"God is a Spirit."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The heaven of heavens can-not con-tain The u-ni-ver-sal Lord; Yet he in hum-ble hearts will deign To dwell and be a-dored.

lines: The heaven of heavens cannot contain
Yet he in humble hearts will deign
Or on the earth, or in the skies,
The God of heaven is there.
Who seek the mercies of our God

licence: Public domain: William Drennan died in 1820.
credits: Words by William Drennan (1754–1820), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
